items.performers: Willard White, Porgy; Cynthia Haymon, Bess; Glyndebourne Chorus; London Philharmonic Orchestra; Simon Rattle, conductor
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: Willard White and Cynthia Haymon lead the Glyndebourne cast under Rattle, with the chorus and the London Philharmonic. ‘Summertime’ and ‘Bess, You Is My Woman Now’ belong to a much larger stage drama.

links.title: Warner Classics — Rattle’s Porgy and Bess

items.work: Concerto in F · An American in Paris
items.performers: André Previn, piano and conductor; London Symphony Orchestra
items.label: EMI / Warner Classics
items.note: Previn plays the piano and conducts the LSO in the Concerto, which Gershwin orchestrated himself. An American in Paris adds taxi horns to the orchestra; Gershwin shopped for them with Mabel Schirmer in Paris in 1928.

links.title: Warner Classics — Previn’s Gershwin orchestral works

items.work: Piano rolls: Rhapsody in Blue and songs
items.performers: George Gershwin, original piano rolls; Artis Wodehouse, realisation
items.label: Nonesuch
items.note: Artis Wodehouse’s realisation transfers Gershwin’s rolls to a concert grand. Gershwin’s fourteen-minute Rhapsody appears beside Swanee, Sweet and Low Down and other songs; the album’s An American in Paris uses a roll by Frank Milne.
